title: Cursor arrow link
description: A text link in the theme's highlight colour (a hot orange in the Cursor theme) with a thin arrow after it: right, up-right for links that leave the page, or down for downloads. Fades to 75% on hover in 150ms.
notes: takes the surrounding font size; pass a text size in className
name: cursor-arrow-link

props.name: arrow
props.description: right: more on this site · up-right: leaves for another page · down: a download · none
